name: Kite
summary: Diamond kite with cross spars and tail bows on a string, centred on x,y in the sky; anim fly makes it sway in the wind.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the kite (sky item)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the kite is about 340 px tall plus a tail of about 380 px

params.name: color
params.note: kite colour (the other panel is yellow)

params.name: accent
params.note: second panel and tail bow colour

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = the kite sways and the tail ripples

author: krakujs
